h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dharmavaram

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Dharmavaram

items.pText: Dharmavaram is known across South India for its silk sarees, and it lies in one of the driest parts of Andhra Pradesh. Long, hot summers and low rainfall mean that sun, more than rain, decides how long outdoor equipment lasts here. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for schools, societies and parks at our factory in Vasai, about 750 km away, and delivers it by road.

In strong sun, a metal slide becomes too hot to touch by noon, and cheap plastic fades and turns brittle. Our slides and decks are roto-moulded and our frames are galvanised, which suits a dry climate well. We still advise shade over slides and platforms, from trees, a building or a separate shade structure. A school can also plan play periods for the cooler morning hours, and keep the afternoon for indoor activities.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Shade and layout for a dry, sunny site

c: Before you fix the layout, watch where the shadows fall between eleven and four on a summer day. Place slides so they face north or east where possible, since a slide facing the afternoon sun heats up fastest. Keep swings in the open and climbers under partial shade. Leave a clear safe play area around each piece, which we mark on the layout drawing. Once you approve it, we manufacture the pieces at Vasai and dispatch them to your site.

items.q: Will roto-moulded slides fade in the Dharmavaram sun?
items.a: All outdoor plastics weather over time, but roto-moulded parts keep their colour much longer than painted metal. Shade over slides slows fading and keeps the surface cooler for children.

items.q: Can you supply a small school in Dharmavaram?
items.a: Yes. Send us the size of the play space and the age group. We will suggest a few pieces that fit and draw the safe play area before you place an order.

items.q: How is the equipment delivered to Dharmavaram?
items.a: We pack the equipment at our Vasai factory and send it by road to Andhra Pradesh. Our installation team or a dealer then installs it on your site.
